title: SlayTheSpire2 (v107)
issues: Running Slay the Spire 2 (Godot 4) on Highball runs at a locked 10/10 frametime once configured, but requires three fixes: First, Godot's default D3D12 renderer fails on D3DMetal because it calls IDXGIFactory2::CreateSwapChainForComposition (unsupported by Apple GPTK, causing audio with a blank green screen), which must be bypassed by placing an override.cfg in the game root forcing Vulkan via MoltenVK (rendering_device/driver="vulkan"). Second, multiplayer proxy DLLs require setting bottle DLL override winmm=n,b (native,builtin) so Wine does not default to its internal stub. Third, Steamworks IPC cannot bridge to macOS Steam.app, requiring a Windows Steam client running directly inside the Wine bottle (WINEMSYNC=0/WINEESYNC=0) for online lobbies.
